# TableRow

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A table row with support for custom styling and background color

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IBackgroundColor`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Properties

- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Background color for this row (applied to cells without their own background)
- [`Cells`](#cells): The cells in this row
- [`Color`](#color): TextBlock color for this row (applied to cells without their own text color)
- [`IsFooter`](#isfooter): Whether this is a footer row
- [`IsHeader`](#isheader): Whether this is a header row
- [`MinHeight`](#minheight): Minimum height for this row (optional)
- [`Padding`](#padding): Custom padding for this row (applied to cells without their own padding)
- [`RunningValue`](#runningvalue): The amount this body row adds to the table's running total, when the table has a `RunningTotalColumn`.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): Always `TR`.
